lede: Data quality management, turned into a product. Score a dataset, fix what failed inside a governed workflow, and publish a version everyone can trust.

facts.label: Status
facts.value: Proof of concept · demonstrated at SPE AI Summit

sections.headline: Measure it. Fix it. Trust it.

body: QualityPlus lets a team upload a dataset, run configurable checks across four quality dimensions, and work every failed cell through a review workflow until a corrected “trusted” version is published.

sections.headline: Bad data gets fixed in spreadsheets.

body: Operational datasets arrive incomplete, duplicated or inconsistent. The fixes usually happen by hand in a copy of a spreadsheet, with no record of what changed, who approved it, or which rules were applied.
Every project also ends up reinventing its own validation rules, so the same mistakes get caught differently, or not at all, depending on who looks.

sections.headline: Quality as a workflow, not a report.

body: A score on its own is not enough; people need a way to act on it. So the score becomes the start of a workflow. AI can suggest at each step, but a person always decides.

value.caption: Step through the workflow, then switch the AI off. Illustrative sample data.

sections.headline: Scoring runs in the browser. AI stays optional.

value.label: QualityPlus architecture
value.caption: The AI features are optional. If a webhook is not configured, that feature is hidden and the core workflow still works.

nodes.detail: Dataset files uploaded into a project.

nodes.title: Quality engine
nodes.detail: Pure TypeScript; scores without a database round-trip.

nodes.title: Supabase
nodes.detail: Scores history, templates, corrections, auth, roles.

nodes.title: Ollama

items.title: Completeness
items.detail: Selected columns must be present and non-empty.

items.title: Uniqueness
items.detail: Single-column or composite-key uniqueness across rows.

items.title: Validity
items.detail: Ranges, thresholds, allowed values, regex and data types, seeded by automatic type inference.

items.title: Consistency
items.detail: Values must match a reference list, an uploaded file, or another dataset already in the platform.

items.title: AI rule check
items.detail: Reads column names against an O&G domain knowledge base, suggests validity rules, and flags columns that should be consistency checks instead.

items.title: AI summary
items.detail: Writes a plain-language summary of a saved score: key issues, links to the failing rows, recommendations.

items.title: AI remediation
items.detail: Suggests a replacement for each failed cell, with a reason and confidence, using passing values from the same column as style examples.

sections.headline: Keep the AI’s answer separate from the human’s.

items.title: Traceable corrections
items.detail: Every fix records whether it was manual, an accepted AI suggestion or a modified one, keeping both the AI’s value and the final value.

items.title: Roles
items.detail: Editors submit corrections; owners and co-owners approve or reject, with a required reason.

items.title: Governed templates
items.detail: A check configuration becomes a template that is reviewed and approved before other projects can reuse it.

items.title: Derived state
items.detail: Workflow phase is computed from failed, addressed and pending counts rather than stored, so it cannot drift.

items.title: A pivot
items.detail: An early Python backend on Render was replaced by talking to Supabase directly. It was simpler to run and there was less to break.

body: The remediation workflow is the most actively developed part: dataset refresh, visual marking of corrected cells and PDF export were the latest additions.

items.title: Separate suggestion from decision
items.detail: Storing the AI’s value next to the human’s made the system auditable, and made the AI easier to evaluate.

items.title: Keep the model swappable
items.detail: The app only talks to n8n webhooks, so where the model runs is a configuration choice in n8n, not a change to the app.

items.title: Governance is a feature
items.detail: Rules only get reused once there is a review step people trust.
